title: Pilatos Caves and Ronda
text: Francisco was an excellent guide. He was fun, knowledgeable, flexible and personable. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience with him.
author: 866marshaf

title: Best day ever!
text:
More ups and downs than expected.

author: miriam_l

title: Come on!
text: Everything was wonderful!! My family loved the treatment and experience that our guide provided, not only because of Ronda's knowledge and history, thanks to him it has been a unique experience!!
author: maritag441

title: A amazing experience.
text: Very impressive experience. We met Miguel, our driver and guide, punctually in the morning. We had a comfortable and efficient journey. Miguel was very nice and accommodated our expectations promptly. The tour to Cueva de la Pileta was extremely amazing. I learnt this special place when I was very young. I can't imagine I can come here personally today to see the incredible drawings. The places was preserved very well by the owner. Our next destination to Ronda was also delightful. author: Jessie L

title: Spectacular day in the Pileta caves and Ronda
text: Our guide Miguel was energetic and a wealth of interesting information during the whole tour. The group going through the caves was large and Miguel assisted us in understanding the bilingual guide. Our time in Ronda was spectacular. Miguel took us on a beautiful walking tour of the old city and we had a delicious lunch in the new city. He was willing to show us more but we ran out of time. Also, he was a very careful driver on the winding roads! We had looked forward to this day trip for months, and it did not disappoint!
author: LISA_P

title: A fabulous day
text: Alfonso was our guide that day and we met him at the tour office. Being the only couple booked we piled into the van and set off on our adventure. It was really enjoyable driving through the countryside towards the Pileta Cave which was our first stop. There are stone steps leading up to the cave entrance which took me about 10 mins to climb as I had to rest a couple of times, being a Senior. Alfonso complimented me on wearing a long sleeve shirt saying it can be cold in the cave even though hot outside. author: L6816JTchrism

title: Nice day in Ronda
text: Alfonso was a great guide, took us to excellent places and restaurants. Ronda is a must to visit with amazing walks and views.
author: Yaron P

title: Off the beaten track back into homo sapien's distant past
text: Although most tourists "head for the hills" to see the white villages (which are delightful and have spectacular views) the highlight of this trip was seeing cave art from 4 distinct eras--amazing to see where homo sapiens from 2500 to 30,000 years ago lived, how they perceived their environment, how their art, culture, religion developed. Mind-blowing
author: susangA1709WG

title: Rock Art, Ronda, and the White Villages
text: Alfonso and Luis were great!  We really enjoyed the views all around Ronda, and especially the 40,000 year-old wall paintings in the caves.  Amazing what people were doing that long ago!  Both Luis and Alfonso gave details of various places as we drove passed and stopped at, and were both very personable.  They made the trip fun and lots of laughs were shared.  Highly recommend!  Thanks for the experience and we’ll look you up the next time we’re in Spain!
author: mstang20

title: Scenic and Action Packed
